# Reset scoreboards so packs can set values accurate for current load.
scoreboard objectives add load.status dummy
scoreboard players reset * load.status

# Confirm load
tellraw @a[tag=convention.debug] {"text":"[Loaded Test Datapack Loading v1.2.3]","color":"green"}
scoreboard players set #tns.loaded load.status 1
function tns:v1.2.3/load/set_items_storage

# If current major is too low, set it to the current major
execute unless score #tns.major load.status matches 1.. run scoreboard players set #tns.major load.status 1

# If current minor is too low, set it to the current minor (only if major is correct)
execute if score #tns.major load.status matches 1 unless score #tns.minor load.status matches 2.. run scoreboard players set #tns.minor load.status 2

# If current patch is too low, set it to the current patch (only if major and minor are correct)
execute if score #tns.major load.status matches 1 if score #tns.minor load.status matches 2 unless score #tns.patch load.status matches 3.. run scoreboard players set #tns.patch load.status 3

# Avoiding multiple executions of the same load function
execute unless score #tns.loaded load.status matches 1 run function tns:v1.2.3/load/secondary

# If correct version, load the datapack
execute if score #tns.major load.status matches 1 if score #tns.minor load.status matches 2 if score #tns.patch load.status matches 3 run function tns:v1.2.3/load/main

# Test Datapack Loading
scoreboard objectives add tns.data dummy
tag test add convention.debug

# Confirm load
function tns:v1.2.3/load/confirm_load

# Move to the next element
